Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character reference sheet for a project of the Olympuz family, binding for every later frame
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes the figure of Iris once and for all, so she can be reproduced identically in every later scene of this project.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column. She is a large, finely carved monumental marble figure with real weight, not a small smooth figurine on a pedestal.
Subject: Iris, the messenger who carries the spoken word, as a white-marble sculpture, shown four times in one row at the same height and the same scale: front view, three-quarter view turned to her left, full profile facing left, and back view. Beside the row, four larger attribute studies: the herald staff alone, the marble writing tablet alone, the winged sandal alone, and the head alone in three-quarter view.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the figures. The four views stand in one straight row across the middle of the frame with equal spacing, each fully inside the frame with clear space above the head and below the base. The four attribute studies sit in a lower band under the row, and that band is FULLY INSIDE the frame: each study, the head study included, stands complete with clear empty space between it and the bottom edge of the image. A study touched or cut by any edge of the frame is the single worst error in this sheet. Generous empty ivory space, nothing overlapping, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, monumental carving with a real cornice profile and deep drapery, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, museum plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming, identical lighting on every view. The gold ribbon and the gold fittings glow softly FROM WITHIN, as if lit by their own material; they are never lit by a lamp, a neon tube or a hard rim light, and no surface is left flat and dead.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the voice ribbon and the metal fittings only, glowing softly along their edges as if lit from within, sky blue #B8D6EA for the incoming paths only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints, and these are the identity of the figure and must be identical in all four views:
- Her head is UNCOVERED and bare. Hair parted in the centre, gathered low at the nape, carved in deep strands. No veil, no helmet, no crown, no band across the eyes.
- Her eyes are open and calm. She wears NO blindfold.
- A classical sleeveless chiton belted high at the waist, with a light mantle over the left shoulder and forearm, carved with deep folds and real thickness.
- Large carved marble wings rise from her shoulders, folded close to her back, feathers cut as real overlapping plates. The wings are marble, never feathers of cloth, and they are present in every view.
- She wears winged sandals: a low marble sandal on each foot with a small carved wing at the ankle, both feet flat on the ground.
- She HOLDS the herald staff in her right hand: a slender muted-gold staff as tall as her shoulder, its butt end resting on the ground beside her right foot and casting a shadow, her fingers closed around the shaft. The head of the staff is a plain smooth ring, with NO snakes, NO wings and NO letters.
- She HOLDS the marble writing tablet in her left hand: a flat rectangular white-marble tablet the size of a forearm, gripped along its lower edge by her closed fingers, held at waist height, its face turned slightly toward the viewer. The tablet face carries ONE carved horizontal groove and nothing else: no letters, no digits, no emblem.
- A single muted-gold ribbon of voice rises from just below her chin, curves once through the air and lands flat on the face of the tablet, ending inside the carved groove. It is one continuous ribbon, it touches the tablet, and it never breaks into pieces and never floats away from her.
- Three thin sky-blue paths run along the ground from the left edge of the frame and CONVERGE at the butt of the herald staff. They lie flat on the ground, touch it along their whole length, and end at the staff; they never rise into the air.
- She stands on a round marble base whose full underside rests on the ground.
- Every view shows the same person wearing the SAME costume: one chiton, one mantle over the same shoulder, one belt at the same height, wings of the same span. The staff shown alone in the study below is the SAME OBJECT she holds: same length, same plain ring head. The tablet shown alone is the same tablet with the same single groove. The sandal shown alone is the same sandal. Nothing changes between views except the angle of the camera.
- Anatomically correct hands with exactly five fingers, natural finger lengths and one clearly readable thumb, fingers not fused.
- Nothing hovers, nothing balances on a point: everything carried is held by a closed hand, everything standing rests on a surface and casts a shadow.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, veil, helmet, crown, blindfold, closed eyes, scales, sword, owl, spear, hearth, fire, floating staff, floating tablet, a ribbon that floats free of the figure, cloth wings, a small smooth featureless figurine, a flat gradient block instead of carved marble, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no measurement marks, no callout labels anywhere in the image.
